analytics.raw_text: Table 6 (printed Tabelle 6) gives the X-ray powder diffractometry pattern of crystal modification II of tembotrione in degrees 2 theta: 49 values, from 7.3765 to 36.7974. Lines 513 to 544. The full list is in the source. See the note on this record: these are the same 49 values, in the same order, that Table 5 prints for modification I.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification II of tembotrione. Table 5 (X-ray powder diffractometry of crystal modification I, lines 472-512) and Table 6 (crystal modification II, lines 513-544) print the same 49 values of 2 theta in the same order, 7.3765 through 36.7974, and claim 5 recites the same list. This was checked value by value against the source. Two polymorphs cannot share one powder pattern, and distinguishing them is what the patent is for. The reading that one of the two captions might name the wrong modification is ruled out by the patent's own Table 7 at lines 545 to 562, which gives modification I as orthorhombic (printed orthorhombisch), space group Pna21, cell volume 1788,91(18) Å3 and modification II as monoclinic (printed monoklin), space group P2(1)/n, cell volume 1814,21(10) Å3: two different crystal systems, with different space groups, different unit cell axes and different cell volumes, cannot produce one diffraction pattern, so no reading of the captions makes both tables correct. What remains is a duplication in the published patent whose direction the document does not reveal: nothing in it says which of the two tables holds the real measurement, and the powder pattern of crystal modification II is therefore not disclosed anywhere in this document. That is not decided here, neither table is corrected and neither is dropped, and each record keeps the attribution its own caption gives. This is a defect in the published patent, not in the transcription. Tabelle 6 captions this list as modification II and this record holds it there unadjusted. Referenced from paragraph [0016].

Named in this section only inside the caption construction Kristallmodifikation II von Tembotrione, which is the whole of what the German prints here. Same molecule as the crystal modification II record in this file, C17H16ClF3O6S: the two records are one substance, one of them named as a crystal form of the other, and must not be read as two. The powder pattern is attributed to the modification and is carried on that record, so this one holds no analytics. No quantity, no characterisation and no synthesis: this section is a table of diffraction angles.
